initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Control Flow Guard (/guard:cf), NX (/NXCOMPAT), ASLR (/DYNAMICBASE /HIGHENTROPYVA), and CET shadow stack (/CETCOMPAT) must remain active.
Windows 11 x64 PE loader requires valid section alignment and W^X page permissions when /guard:cf and /CETCOMPAT are enabled.

measurements.notes: Merging .rdata into .text with /ALIGN:16 reduced raw file size by 4480 bytes on disk, but violated Windows 11 loader section alignment and Control Flow Guard read-only metadata table requirements.

diagnostics.summary: lld-link warning and Windows 11 PE loader rejection (0xC000007B) when combining /MERGE:.rdata=.text and /ALIGN:16 with /guard:cf and /CETCOMPAT.
diagnostics.preservation_statement: Failed sub-page alignment + section merge experiment is preserved with its exact flags and byte measurements; the compact_experiment preset keeps standard section alignment and full security mitigations without silently disabling /guard:cf or /CETCOMPAT.
